title: 14. Kilo-Kilo Fruit (Kiro Kiro no Mi)
facts: Fruit look from the user's oparchive screenshots (refs/batch3/DESIGNS.md)

plan.fruit: Drawn from the design you sent (refs/batch3).

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird weight-shaped#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird weight-shaped fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a Paramecia#orange that changes#gold how heavy you are.
lines.say: a Paramecia that changes how heavy you are.

lines.text: First, you become as light as a feather#orange and float on an umbrella.#green
lines.say: First, you become as light as a feather and float on an umbrella.

lines.text: Then you drop on enemies#green at ten thousand#purple kilos.
lines.say: Then you drop on enemies at ten thousand kilos.

lines.text: You can switch your weight instantly,#orange anywhere#purple between one and ten thousand kilos.
lines.say: You can switch your weight instantly, anywhere between one and ten thousand kilos.

lines.text: Your strongest#blue move is a ten thousand#gold kilo crush from the sky.
lines.say: Your strongest move is a ten thousand kilo crush from the sky.

lines.text: If your enemy just steps aside, you hit nothing#pink but the ground.#gold
lines.say: If your enemy just steps aside, you hit nothing but the ground.

lines.text: Miss Valentine#orange of Baroque#gold Works used it, until Luffy beat her at Whisky Peak.
lines.say: Miss Valentine of Baroque Works used it, until Luffy beat her at Whisky Peak.

lines.text: Users of this fruit never worry#green about#pink the scale.
lines.say: Users of this fruit never worry about the scale.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
